name: Tales of the Ancient Elves
source:
Olivia finds an untitled book that immerses her more and more in the beauty of the elven world with every new chapter. The girl starts having realistic dreams of the magical world.

During her next dream, Olivia realizes that she can no longer wake up and return to the reality. Now she must find a way out of the book world and solve the major mystery - who is the author of the unnamed book.

[from [url=https://vkplay.ru/play/game/elventales/]vkplay.ru[/url]]
